title: Return a powered enclosure guard to service
instruction: Repair the detached edge and leave the enclosure guard ready for operation.
context: A short section of rubber has come loose from the lower rail of a vertical loading guard. The next shift will use this opening.
setup: A vertical 300 mm rail, outboard green cycle button, guided orange instrument and fixed loading shelf share the bench. A blue sleeve and yellow gloved hand rest on the shelf.
scoring: 0.5 for seating. 0.75 adds loaded reversal, 15 mm probe travel, flag rise and reopening within 5 mm. Full credit adds return to holder and 1 s released dwell. Operator contact, powered sweep contact, 30 mm overtravel or a probe left out at timeout latches zero.
run_limit: 1,200 actions at 20 Hz. Seed 0 and zero object jitter.
reset_notes: Open the guard. Turn out the loose clip section with continuity intact. Park the unloaded instrument, release the cycle button and reset the indicator.
fidelity: A 300 mm working section retains a full-size edge cross-section and 122 mm stroke. A spring-loaded orange cylinder travels on a guided carriage. A separate adult-size forearm and gloved hand are fixed to the loading shelf. A passive roll joint approximates seating one clip lip. Travel limits describe this fixture. Hardware performance and injury thresholds remain unvalidated.
scores: YAM reference 1.0 in 533 actions. Empty cycle 0.5, displaced edge 0.0, probe left in path 0.00. Dream-1 0.00 in 1200 actions.
